title: Register with the construction industry long service scheme
what: Register with the scheme as an employer of workers covered by the state or territory's portable long service leave scheme.

laws.title: Construction Industry Long Service Leave Act 1997 (Vic)

sources.title: Construction Industry Long Service Leave Act 1997 (Vic)
sources.publisher: Victorian Legislation (authorised version saved by the owner)
sources.locator: s 4(1) (authorised version 014, saved by the owner)
sources.quote: (1) An employer must pay to the trustee a long service leave charge in respect of every worker employed by the employer to perform construction work in the construction industry.

sources.title: Employers
sources.quote: Employers and workers in Victoria’s construction industry are required to be part of the LeavePlus portable long service leave scheme — supporting workers to take a well-earned break when they need it most.

confidence_note: Quoted from the authorised PDF the owner saved from the Victorian register (data/raw/vic_legislation/, not committed); the register's documents disallow automated fetching. The regulator's guidance quoted before is kept as a second source. The Act's duty is to pay the long service leave charge for each construction worker; registration with the scheme (CoINVEST) follows from its trust deed, quoted from the scheme's page.

assessment.summary: Employers in a covered industry must register with its portable long service leave scheme.

marks.reason: Workers keep their long service entitlement when they move between employers in the industry.
